items.t: Held breath. Something is about to happen and everyone knows it.
Fond exasperation. This again, but not really minding.
Quiet triumph nobody is allowed to mention.
The giggles. Something not funny has become very funny.
Bracing. Bad news is coming through the door and everyone has already moved to positions.
Deflation. It did not work. Nobody is saying so.
Getting away with it. Guilty faces, no witnesses, one witness.
Mild panic conducted at a whisper.
Reunion. Somebody has been away three days and it is being treated as three years.
Sulking, with an audience, for effect.
